title: Accessing a private static property via static:: in a non-final class fails in subclasses

ground_truth.statement: Late static binding resolves static::$count to the called subclass SubCounter. Because SubCounter defines its own private static int $count = 2, BaseCounter::readCount() cannot access SubCounter::$count: BaseCounter::readCount() returns 1, while SubCounter::readCount() throws Error at runtime.

notes: PHPStan 2.3.1 reports staticClassAccess.privateProperty on static::$count inside non-final BaseCounter. Both Mago 1.60.2 and Psalm 6.20.1 stay silent, even though SubCounter::readCount() throws Error: Cannot access private property SubCounter::$count at runtime.
